title: The asymmetry of the awareness state reproduces global ignition

statements.text: In simulations, deciding that content is present produces more summed prediction error across the perceptual layers than deciding it is absent, which offers a computational account of the global ignition seen in imaging studies of awareness reports.

sources.quote: Via simulations I show that this asymmetry provides a natural account of observations of “global ignition” in brain imaging studies of awareness reports.
